2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new concept of 'common memory' in the Linux kernel, which is used to determine where ordinary allocations and node-scoped services can access memory. The patch adds two new functions, `folio_is_common_memory()` and `page_is_common_memory()`, to help MM services identify common memory. These functions are designed to replace existing checks for zone device folios.
